pages.title: Echo Deep
pages.creator: Sidrick
pages.description: Pilot a small submarine through unlit caves in Echo Deep. A sonar ping briefly shows the walls, but it also draws fish toward you. Drop a noisy buoy to distract them while you look for pearls and an exit. Navigate currents and jellyfish across twelve levels and upgrade the submarine along the way.

pages.title: Bubble Match Merge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pull bubbles together to connect matching items in Bubble Match Merge. Check the level goal before choosing which bubbles to combine, since every board gives you a limited number of moves. Try to set up matches that help finish the objective while leaving room for the next pull.

pages.title: Gold Miner Classic
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Send a swinging hook down to haul up gold in Gold Miner Classic. Wait until it points at a valuable nugget before you tap. Rocks take time to pull up, so look for a clear shot at the gold. Reach the level's money target before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Neon Gravity
pages.creator: Half Blood Games
pages.description: Flip gravity to dodge spikes, saws, and mines in Neon Gravity. Time your switch through rotating gears to earn a Perfect bonus. The run speeds up as your score rises, so read the next gap quickly. Keep playing to unlock ten skins, including the Ninja and the Eye.

pages.title: Athena Match 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Join Athena in restoring temples in Athena Match 2. Make groups of at least three matching artifacts to work through the puzzles set in ancient Greece. Follow the temple restoration across the levels, or take on a daily mission when you want another challenge.

pages.title: Cake Link Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Connect pairs of matching cakes in Cake Link Master. The line between two cakes can turn twice at most, and other tiles can't block it. Clear pairs that open more routes through the board and see how far you can get through the 120 layouts.

pages.title: Ammo Rush Master
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Build up your supply of foam darts as you run in Ammo Rush Master. Steer around obstacles and choose gates that multiply the darts you carry. Once you reach the shooting section, put that ammo to work blasting targets and enemies, including the bosses.

pages.title: Cosmic Dash
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Race through the solar system in Cosmic Dash. Dodge debris, break through asteroids, and pick up tokens while the run keeps moving. Use boosts, jumps, and the ability to shrink to get through different stretches of the route and keep your score climbing.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter GO
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Aim your shots to make bubble matches in Bubble Shooter GO. Use angles to reach groups of bubbles and set up combos, then put boosters to work when the board gets crowded. Progress through the solo stages or take on a friend or another opponent in a one-on-one duel.

pages.title: Magic Princess: Dress Up Doll
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Create an anime-style chibi doll in Magic Princess: Dress Up Doll. Try different clothing combinations and change the look as you go. Start with a style you have in mind or build it piece by piece as you see what suits your character.

pages.title: Master Blender
pages.creator: HongKong WOSO Technology Co., Limited
pages.description: Sort colored liquid into the right cups in Master Blender. Tap a bottle to pour and check where its contents are headed before making the next move. Keep organizing the liquid until each color has reached its matching cup.

pages.title: Noob in Geometry Dash
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Guide Nubik through rhythm-based obstacle courses in Noob in Geometry Dash. Time your moves to the beat and keep an eye out for keys along the route. Use the keys to unlock skins, finish more courses, and see how your results compare in the rankings.

pages.title: Hero Tower Wars Merge Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Move your hero through the tower floors in Hero Tower Wars Merge Puzzle. Check the numbers on the enemies before deciding whom to fight first, and build up your hero through merges. Use the strength you've gained and a better sword to take on enemies you couldn't beat at the start.

pages.title: Unicorn Find The Differences
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Compare pairs of unicorn illustrations in Unicorn Find The Differences. Look for details that change between the two pictures and mark each one you spot. Check similar areas side by side for smaller changes as you work toward completing the scene and unlocking the next level.

pages.title: Idle Inventor
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Build a factory from a single production line in Idle Inventor. Expand into cars, trucks, aircraft, military vehicles, and equipment for space exploration. Automate production so the factory can keep working while you're away, then return to decide what to build up with the money it earned.

pages.title: Infinite Craft
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Start with fire, earth, water, and wind in Infinite Craft. Combine two elements to see what they produce, then mix your discoveries with earlier ingredients. Follow one combination into a chain of new results or try an unlikely pairing and see where it leads.

pages.title: Jinn Dash
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Move a magic carpet to bounce the ball into the bricks in Jinn Dash. Keep the ball in play and adjust where it hits the carpet to send it toward the bricks you still need. Clear the layout to finish the round.

pages.title: Number Sweeper 3D
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Turn every numbered tile into a zero in Number Sweeper 3D. Tap blank tiles to subtract one from the numbers next to them. Look at which numbers each blank affects before choosing it. Keep working through the layouts as the numbers and their neighbors change.

pages.title: Space Pet Link
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Pair up alien pets in Space Pet Link. Look for connections that clear tiles from the field and give you more room to work. Try the easy setting when you want a gentler puzzle, or choose hard mode and see whether you can clear the board before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Scary Chicken Feet Escape Game
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Search a creepy house and rescue your captive companion in Scary Chicken Feet Escape Game. Explore the rooms while looking for a way around the captor. Once you've found your companion, work out how to escape the house before the search catches up with you.

pages.title: You vs 100 Skibidi Toilets
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Play a Cameraman facing a hundred enemies in You vs 100 Skibidi Toilets. Take down the Skibidi Toilets using the weapons you have, then spend your earnings to unlock more gear. You can also change your Cameraman's outfit before going back into the fight.

pages.title: Grandma Recipe Nigiri Sushi
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Follow Grandma's recipe to prepare nigiri for visiting friends in Grandma Recipe Nigiri Sushi. Gather the tools and ingredients, shape the rice, and finish each piece with its toppings. You can also choose a costume as you get ready to serve the meal.

pages.title: Race Burnout Drift
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race other drivers and work on your drifts in Race Burnout Drift. Steer with the arrow keys, use Space to brake, and press Shift for nitro. Judge your speed before a turn and use the boost when you have a clear stretch of road ahead.

pages.title: Super Stickman Duelist
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Swing your weapon by rotating your fighter in Super Stickman Duelist. Move close enough for the blade to reach the opponent and time your turn so it connects. Pick up replacement weapons from the platforms or defeated enemies, and unlock stronger options as you play.

pages.title: Donut Stack
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Make and collect doughnuts as you move through the course in Donut Stack. Guide your stack around obstacles while picking up the food you want to carry. Get the doughnuts through the run and serve them to the customers waiting at the end.

pages.title: Find A Difference
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Put two pictures side by side and spot what changed in Find A Difference. Scan the images for details that are missing, moved, or altered, then mark each difference you find. Try to finish quickly before moving on to another pair of photos.

pages.title: Nonogram Jigsaw
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Use number clues to fill the grid in Nonogram Jigsaw. Think through the rows and columns as you work out which squares to mark. Solving a level earns a jigsaw piece. Collect the pieces to complete illustrations and unlock more themes.

pages.title: Jump Ball
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Send a bouncing ball down a tower of spinning platforms in Jump Ball. Smash through the colored sections when they line up beneath you, but hold off when a red section comes around. Hitting red shatters the ball and sends you back to the start of the fall.

pages.title: Words Swipe
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Swipe across letter blocks to spell words in Words Swipe. Correct words remove their letters from the layout. Use the clues at the top to work out what to look for, and ask for help if a word has you stuck. Find every word to clear the level.

pages.title: Metal Army War
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight off a robotic army in Metal Army War on your own or with a friend. Break traps, take out enemies, and rescue the hostages along the way. Spend the metal you collect on better weapons or more health, then face the boss at the end of the campaign.

pages.title: Kittygram
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fit cat-shaped pieces together to fill the outline in Kittygram. Look at the spaces around each piece as you work out which shape belongs where. The tangram puzzles are split across eight difficulty settings, with 72 layouts in each setting.

pages.title: Blondie and Friends Summer Fashion Show
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put together a warm-weather runway look in Blondie and Friends Summer Fashion Show. Try flowing skirts and floral prints, or mix blouses, jackets, and trousers to build your own outfit. Add makeup before Blondie and her friend take their looks onto the runway.

pages.title: Run Of Life 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Guide a character through a lifetime in Run Of Life 3D. Pay attention to the choices along the course and how they affect your age. Try to reach the end while you're still young enough to keep going, then start another life on the next level.

pages.title: Olimpian Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Pair up tiles showing winter sports in Olimpian Mahjong. Look for two identical tiles you can remove, then see which parts of the layout open up. Work through the board using designs based on events at the Beijing Winter Olympics.

pages.title: Lateral Defense
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Defend against falling red and yellow balls in Lateral Defense. The button below fires red shots, and the one on the right fires yellow. Match each shot to the incoming ball's color and switch between the two buttons as the targets come down.

pages.title: Mahjong Around The World Africa
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Clear timed mahjong boards to free ten animals in Mahjong Around The World Africa. Find matching pairs and see which tiles open up after each removal. Use a hint if a match is hard to spot, or swap tiles when you need a different layout.

pages.title: Ghostly Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Rebuild Halloween pictures in Ghostly Jigsaw. Drag each piece into place and use the picture details to see which pieces belong together. Choose the 24-piece layout or try the 48-piece version, then see whether you can finish before the clock runs out.

pages.title: My Shark Show
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Put on an aquarium show as a shark in My Shark Show. Jump through flaming hoops, collect meat, and snap up fish as you perform for the crowd. Pick up coins during the levels and trade them for new shark skins or other sea creatures.

pages.title: Forest Match
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Match fruits, plants, and other woodland items in Forest Match. Look at the current mission before making a move so your matches help with the objective. Work through the forest boards and return to the daily challenges for new goals.

pages.title: Find Pair
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Clear the board in Find Pair by selecting two identical objects at a time. Look closely at the shapes and pictures before choosing a pair. Keep matching as the timer runs down, until there are no objects left to take.

pages.title: Sky City Riders
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race a motorbike across skyscraper rooftops in Sky City Riders. Save a burst of nitro for long ramps and finish before time runs out. Clear ten timed races to unlock bike skins, race a friend in two-player mode, or collect diamonds in Free Driving.

pages.title: War Stars Medical Emergency
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma, Mia, Sophie, and Clara in War Stars Medical Emergency. Work through different tasks, including Emma's dental care, Mia's makeover, and Sophie's mermaid treatment. Help with Clara's throat problem and solve a puzzle so she can return to space.

pages.title: Solitaire Collection: Klondike, Spider & FreeCell
pages.creator: Holger Sindbaek
pages.description: Choose a classic card game in Solitaire Collection: Klondike, Spider & FreeCell. Switch between the three layouts, use a hint when you're stuck, or undo a move to try a different sequence. In Klondike, adjust the draw setting to turn over one card or three at a time.

pages.title: Learning English: Word Connect
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag through letters to spell individual words in Learning English: Word Connect. Try different orders when a word doesn't come to mind, or use a hint to get unstuck. Work through 72 levels of vocabulary puzzles.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Candy Cane
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Clear a winter-themed layout in Arkadium's Mahjongg Candy Cane. Look for pairs of matching tiles you can remove, then use the space they open to reach more matches. Work through the stacked board with its holiday designs.

pages.title: Coloring And Learn
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Make a drawing from scratch in Coloring And Learn. Use Free mode to sketch, doodle, or fill in a picture with your own colors. Switch to Glow mode to draw with neon paint and try the same idea with brighter lines.

pages.title: Spot the Difference 2
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find three changes between two pictures in Spot the Difference 2. Compare matching areas for details that have moved or changed before the timer expires. The next puzzle might feature animals, people, household objects, or a scene outdoors.

pages.title: Ninja VS Slime
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Throw ninja stars at the advancing slimes in Ninja VS Slime. Use ricochets to land several hits from a single throw. Some slimes can take dozens of hits, so focus on the ones getting close and look for angles that also reach the group behind them.

pages.title: Fried Noodles
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Prepare a noodle dish in Fried Noodles. Follow the cooking steps to boil the noodles, prepare the pan, and fry the ingredients. Use the mouse or tap to work with the kitchen tools as you move from preparation to the finished dish.

pages.title: Ferrari F8 Tributo Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures of the Ferrari F8 Tributo and rebuild it from jigsaw pieces. Start with 16 pieces or make the same image harder with 36, 64, or 100. Look at the car's lines and details when you're deciding where a piece belongs.

pages.title: Delicious Food Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match three or more of the same food in Delicious Food Match 3 Deluxe. Check the target for each level and look for combinations that help you reach it. Use bombs, hourglasses, and other special pieces when the board gets harder.

pages.title: PaintWars Shoot
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Play a first-person paintball match in PaintWars Shoot. Enter a multiplayer match to face other players, or choose single player and fight against bots. Keep track of where opponents move as you aim, and try a different approach if you keep getting caught in the open.

pages.title: Tank Wars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Defend your base while taking out enemy armor in Tank Wars. Fight through 120 battlefields alone or with a friend, and choose from four difficulty options. Keep an eye on your base while you attack, since losing it ends the mission. You can also build your own arenas.

pages.title: DEUL Kids
pages.creator: Greenlight Games
pages.description: Draw faster than your opponents in DEUL Kids. Time your shot and aim accurately as the duels take you through locations including London, China, Russia, and Brazil. Each victory adds to your score and gives you another chance to move up the leaderboard.

pages.title: Mafia Wars
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Play a cowboy fighting the mob in Mafia Wars. Take on enemy groups and bosses, then unlock stronger weapons and allies as you advance. Watch your ammunition as the fight develops so you still have rounds for the enemies that take longer to bring down.

pages.title: Pixel Wars Apocalypse Zombie
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Survive a blocky zombie outbreak in Pixel Wars Apocalypse Zombie. Try survival with other players, join a team or free-for-all deathmatch, or enter the mode that puts you on the zombie side. Each mode changes who you're up against.

pages.title: Xmas Lights Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick two identical lights in the same row or column in Xmas Lights Puzzles. Every light between them goes away too. Look at what will be left before clearing a stretch, since a move can remove the only matching partner for a light you'll need later.

pages.title: Smash Glass
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Drop balls onto filled glasses in Smash Glass. Look at how the glasses are arranged and choose where a ball will land so it can knock one over. Clear the layout by tipping every glass and spilling its contents.

pages.title: Xmas Cards Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn over two cards at a time in Xmas Cards Match. Remember where each holiday character appears, then use that information to find its match on a later turn. Pair all the cards on the board to complete the level.

pages.title: Stunt Car Challenge Game
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Drive through stunt courses in Stunt Car Challenge Game, then take on other drivers in the multiplayer racing arena. Get used to how the car handles through the course and improve its performance as you progress. Try out your changes on the next run.

pages.title: Ancient Egypt Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Line up at least three identical ancient Egyptian objects in Ancient Egypt Match 3. Look for new matches as the layout changes and keep building your score. Watch the gauge on the left as you play. If it drops too far, the game ends.

pages.title: Outerspace Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Swap neighboring pieces in Outerspace Match 3 to line up three or more of the same color. Each match clears those pieces from the space-themed board. Check the rows and columns after a move to see what other groups you can make.

pages.title: Flight Simulator C130 Training
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take the controls of a C-130 military transport in Flight Simulator C130 Training. Learn to handle the aircraft in training, then put that practice to work on missions. Get a feel for how the transport responds to your inputs as you work through the different flight tasks.

pages.title: Zombie Killers
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Steer a soldier through a zombie outbreak in Zombie Killers. Slide the mouse or your finger to change direction as you shoot the walking dead. Look for survivors you can rescue while staying clear of the zombies closing in.

pages.title: 8 Ball Pool With Friends
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Face another player at the pool table in 8 Ball Pool With Friends. The first ball potted determines who plays spots and who plays stripes. Aim for the lowest number on the table and leave the 8-ball for the final shot.

pages.title: Retro Ball
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Keep a rolling ball on the platforms in Retro Ball. Move with WASD and press Space to jump when you need to cross a gap. The course keeps going, so watch where the ball will land and try to beat your best score.

pages.title: Bears Adventures
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Choose a bear and take on missions across different worlds in Bears Adventures. Move and jump with the arrow keys or WASD, fire with Space, and use the mouse for your special skill. Defeat the enemies in each mission and improve your character as you advance.

pages.title: Motorbike Stunts
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a bike out to practice tricks in Motorbike Stunts. Choose from eight motorbikes and ride across four maps. Look for a spot to attempt a stunt, then see what it adds to your score. Try another bike or map when you want to change up the run.

pages.title: Viking Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Guess where your opponent will move and throw your sword in Viking Wars. If the throw misses, pick the sword up and get back into the duel. Play against a friend or take on the computer in the tournament.

pages.title: Monsters Up
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Jump onto rising stacks of logs and stones in Monsters Up. Watch the incoming pieces and tap when your monster can land safely. Reaching a star changes the monster's appearance. Miss a landing and you'll have to start the climb again.

pages.title: EG Animal Rush
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Guide an animal along narrow platforms in EG Animal Rush. Click at the right moment to turn at corners or jump across openings. Watch the edge of the path as the animal runs, then work through the next layout once you reach the finish.

pages.title: Public Service Puzzle
pages.creator: Aurora Games
pages.description: Choose a difficulty in Public Service Puzzle and fit the interlocking pieces together. Use the edges and details in the picture to work out where each one belongs. Finish the image, then try another difficulty when you want to change the challenge.

pages.title: Yummy Slot Machine
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Spin reels with food symbols in Yummy Slot Machine. Watch what lines up after each spin and see which combinations pay out. The game uses a classic slot-machine layout, with the different food pictures taking the place of standard reel symbols.

pages.title: Falling Ball
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Roll a ball across platforms in Falling Ball. Line up with the next surface and pick up boosts when you have a clear path to them. Spend time in the air to improve your score, but keep an eye on where you'll land so you don't fall.

pages.title: Fort Shooter Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Build a fort and practice with different weapons in Fort Shooter Simulator. Work in a 3D space where you can put a structure together, then switch to weapons and get familiar with how they handle. Try out a different setup when you want to change the layout.

pages.title: Wheels On the Bus
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Ride along with Tiger, Elephant, Rabbit, Monkey, and Fox in Wheels On the Bus. Listen to the song as the animals travel, then tap parts of the scene to see what they do. Turn on the lights, honk the horn, or make the bird sing.

pages.title: Right Color
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Decide whether a color word matches the color shown in Right Color. Read the word and check the display before you choose your answer. The two can disagree, so pay attention to both instead of answering from the name alone.

pages.title: Strong Lions Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Choose one of six lion pictures in Strong Lions Jigsaw. Start with 16 pieces or try a 36-, 64-, or 100-piece puzzle. Use the shapes and details of the image to place pieces, and see how quickly you can finish the whole picture.

pages.title: Billy the kid
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Play the sheriff and stop an outlaw gang in Billy the kid. Check who has appeared before you shoot, since townspeople are mixed in with the gang. Take out Billy's men while avoiding civilians and try to save the mayor's daughter.

pages.title: Princesses Runway Plus
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style Ariel, Belle, Jasmine, and Elsa for the catwalk in Princesses Runway Plus. Browse the clothes and put together a different look for each of the four models. Decide who should open the show once the princesses are dressed for the runway.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Spring
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Put together sixteen spring scenes in Jigsaw Puzzle: Spring. Pick a picture and use the outlines and image details to work out which pieces fit together. Finish one scene, then choose another to work with a new set of shapes and colors.

pages.title: Space Cord
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Race through space in Space Cord. Look for trophies along the energy platforms while steering around traps. Decide which pickups you can reach without putting yourself in the path of a hazard, and try to keep the run going as long as you can.

pages.title: Forest Fairy Dressup
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Pick a colorful outfit for Mila in Forest Fairy Dressup. She's expecting visitors in the forest after dark and wants a new look. Try different clothing combinations on the fairy until you've found one you'd like her to wear when the campers arrive.

pages.title: Penalty Kicks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Swipe to set the direction and power of your shot in Penalty Kicks. Aim for an opening in the goal, then send the ball past the goalkeeper. Adjust the length or direction of your next swipe if the keeper gets in the way.

pages.title: DUO
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide a rotating pair of dots upward in DUO. Tap to climb and watch both dots as they turn. Wait for an opening wide enough for the pair to pass, then move through without letting either dot touch an obstacle.

pages.title: Princesses Pop Party Trends
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress Jasmine and Cinderella for two different parties in Princesses Pop Party Trends. Decide whether they'll go to the rock and disco party or the princess ball first. Pick outfits that fit the setting before the friends head out for the evening.

pages.title: Sushi Bar
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Prepare sushi in Sushi Bar by choosing ingredients for the dishes you need to make. Check the recipe book if you forget what goes into a dish. Use the mouse to select the ingredients and put the order together at the counter.

pages.title: Butterfly Kyodai 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Connect matching butterfly wings in Butterfly Kyodai 2. Look for pairs that can link across the layout and clear them to make room for other connections. Work through the board as quickly as you can until all the butterflies are gone.

pages.title: Cute Harley Quinn Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Put together a look for Harley Quinn in Cute Harley Quinn Dress Up. Try different clothing combinations on the character and see how the pieces work together. Build an outfit around the harlequin theme or change the style as you explore the wardrobe.

pages.title: Kittens Selfie Time
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Get two kittens ready for a photo in Kittens Selfie Time. Pick clothes, shoes, accessories, and hairstyles for each kitten. Change the background after you've chosen their outfits, then bring both looks together for the selfie.
